content.text: I added `GET /api/messages/{id}` in `src/app/api/messages/[id]/route.ts`, backed by a new `getMessageForRecipient` query in `src/repos/messages.ts`. The query only matches when the caller is the recipient and in the same practice, so anyone else, including admins and users of another practice, gets a 404. Unauthenticated requests get 401. The recipient gets exactly `{id, subject, body, sentAt, from:{name}}`, and the message is marked read. I also record a `message.read` audit entry that holds ids only. I added `tests/message-read.test.ts`, and `npm run verify` passes (typecheck plus all 21 tests).
